eligibility.summary: An SSH project must be submitted by an organized group that is motivated, has identified a real need, and has already successfully implemented projects in the community. The project should be feasible and based on the socio-economic context of the local community. Organizational Requirements: All applicants must be registered Non-Profit Organizatio In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Institutional limits apply as detailed in the opportunity announcement; verify internal screening procedures.
important_notes: Opportunity Number: AFPRA-20-04 — Agency: U.S. Mission to Cape Verde.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity AFPRA-20-04.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
